async def act(page):
    # The search has already been performed, and we are on the search results page.
    # Wait for the page to be fully loaded.
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Locate the third search result by targeting the title links within the articles under main.
    # Use the accessibility tree structure: main > article > heading > link.
    result_links = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('article').get_by_role('heading').get_by_role('link')
    third_result = result_links.nth(2)  # Zero-indexed, so nth(2) is the third link
    await third_result.click()
    # After clicking, the page will navigate to the result page, completing the task.
